summary: Wheels Up Experience Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a $100.0 million unsecured term loan credit agreement with existing lenders Delta Air Lines, Cox Investment Holdings, and CK Wheels on May 29, 2026, with proceeds for working capital and fleet expansion. The loan matures May 29, 2029, with an accordion feature for up to $100.0 million additional. No change of control or special situation is involved; this is a routine debt financing. No board recommendation or advisor named, and no event-driven risk-arb angle applies.
